title: About
text:
I am a reliable and detail‑oriented Virtual Assistant with experience supporting U.S.-based businesses through administrative assistance, customer service, CRM management, and daily operations support. My goal is to help business owners stay organized so they can focus on growing their business.
In my current role supporting a U.S. lawn care company, I manage customer communications via phone, email, and text, maintain accurate CRM records, assist with scheduling, process administrative tasks, and ensure customers receive prompt and professional service. Working with U.S. clients has strengthened my communication skills, attention to detail, and ability to work independently in a fast‑paced remote environment.
Before transitioning into virtual assistance, I spent more than six years in agricultural research and field operations. That experience developed my organizational skills, accuracy in documentation, data management, problem‑solving, and ability to follow standard operating procedures—skills that translate seamlessly into remote administrative work.
I am proficient in Microsoft Office, Google Workspace, CRM systems and other productivity tools. I am a fast learner who adapts quickly to new software and workflows, and I take pride in producing accurate, high‑quality work with minimal supervision.



Customer Support (Phone, Email & Chat)

CRM Management and Data Entry

Email and Inbox Management

Calendar and Appointment Scheduling

Administrative Support

Internet Research

Spreadsheet Management (Excel & Google Sheets)

Documentation and Report Preparation

File Organization

Process Improvement

I value clear communication, reliability, and professionalism. If you’re looking for a dependable Virtual Assistant who is proactive, organized, and committed to helping your business succeed, I’d be happy to be part of your team.
